li-uli.description: Li-Uli is a Tangerang Selatan-based Indonesian wastra fashion and craft brand founded by Ida R. Tampubolon. The brand develops bags, wallets and fashion pieces that combine traditional Indonesian woven textiles with contemporary product design, with roots in Tenun Balige and Ulos Batak.
li-uli.address: Vermont Parkland Blok G.1/21, BSD, Kota Tangerang Selatan, Banten 15321, Indonesia

ageman-ecoprint.description: Ageman Ecoprint is a sustainable fashion brand from Tangerang Selatan founded in 2021. The label develops ecoprint and natural-dye fashion using plant-derived motifs and materials, with an emphasis on natural fibers, responsible production and zero-waste reuse.
ageman-ecoprint.address: Jl. Raya Puspiptek Kp No. 83, Setu, Tangerang Selatan, Banten 15312, Indonesia

dkait-craft.description: Dkait Craft is a Tangerang Selatan knitwear and handicraft brand producing knitted baby clothing, hats, scarves, tops and related apparel. Public research identifies Sandriana Sandra as the owner and notes production activity since 2016; the Dkait Craft mark was filed in 2021 in class 25 for knitted apparel, with a South Tangerang address in Rempoa.
dkait-craft.address: Komp. Puri Flamboyan, Jl. Flamboyant Kencana No.12 B Blok A.5, Rempoa, Kec. Ciputat Tim., Kota Tangerang Selatan, Banten 15412, Indonesia

ilalang-craft.description: Ilalang Craft is a Tangerang Selatan handmade knitwear brand founded in 2019 by Eli Suswati. The business is known for manually knitted footwear made from polyester cord and serves customers from toddlers to adults; its Ilalang Craft word-and-device mark is recorded in class 25 for knitted shoes.
ilalang-craft.address: Griya Asri Pamulang Blok E9/14, Bakti Jaya, Setu, Kota Tangerang Selatan, Banten 15315, Indonesia

owi-rajut.description: Owi Rajut is a Tangerang Selatan knitting-yarn business with trademark application DID2021064524, received on 27 September 2021 in class 23 for knitting yarn and hand-knitting yarn. A 2022 Universitas Pamulang study also records Owi Rajut in a local UMKM dataset at approximately latitude -6.35540522545654 and longitude 106.712101733721.
